描述_EN: a fine reserve border lined with a frieze of posts completes the composition. square of polychrome tapestry. the piece is decorated with a central fruit bowl surrounded by a green circle, set in a reserved square. spandrels left free are occupied by small leaves. a very wide red border, embellished at the corners with small reserved medallions featuring birds, frames the whole. between the medallions are small green lozenges whose inner spaces are decorated with geometric motifs created with a flying shuttle.
描述_ZN: 保留了一个精细的边框，衬以柱子的楣，完成了构图。 方的多色织锦。 该作品的装饰是由一碗水果的中心组成，周围是一个绿色的圆圈，在一个方形的预留位置上刻着。 空闲的窗台被小叶子占据。 一个非常宽的红色边框，在四角点缀着预留的容纳鸟类的小奖章，框住了整个画面。 在勋章之间是绿色的小菱形，其内部用飞梭装饰着几何图案。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
